title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents | TechCrunch
summary: Safety and security require full-stack engineering.” The new Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform combines OpenShell, its open source software for controlling what agents can access while they operate, with Sentry, an independent monitoring system that runs on Nvidia’s BlueField-4 data processing units.
